overview_description.description: The Digital Hotelier is a cutting-edge SaaS company providing innovative solutions to the hospitality industry. With their advanced platform, hotels can enable their guests to effortlessly order and book any service they desire with just a click of a button. The platform also offers a convenient multilingual interface for holiday homes and hotel apartment guests to order all their needs from a single, comprehensive platform, eliminating the need to download multiple apps. The Digital Hotelier sets itself apart from the competition by delivering exceptional service and providing a seamless experience for guests and hotel staff alike.

product.name: The Digital Hotelier Guest Experience Platform
product.description: A web-based platform enabling hotel guests to order services, book facilities, and communicate with staff via QR codes without app downloads.

product.name: TeamStream Operations Management App
product.description: A mobile and web app for hotel staff to manage housekeeping, maintenance, complaints, and task assignments with real-time tracking and communication.

product.name: External Services Integration
product.description: Integration of third-party service providers like taxi, car rental, pharmacy, and entertainment into the guest platform to expand service offerings and generate revenue.

product.name: Multi-language Native Translation Support
product.description: Support for up to seven native languages on the guest platform, enabling guests to interact in their preferred language without additional charges.

product.name: Promotional Banners and Marketing Management
product.description: A dashboard feature allowing hotels to create, manage, and translate up to 12 promotional banners, including clickable image and video banners.
